gazetteer.title: DEEP: the English Place-Name Society survey (county volume Cambridgeshire)
gazetteer.description: Place-centric PLATO serialisation of the DEEP MADS XML (Jisc, 2017 release; mirrored 2026-09-26), county volume Cambridgeshire. Generated and schema-validated against PLATO v0.4.0 (release 0.4.0, commit ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832). Identifiers are https://w3id.org/whg-epns/<county>/<serial>, carrying DEEP's own 2013 numbering (registration by the World Historical Gazetteer, pending merge at generation time). Licence: Digitisation of English Placenames MADS data is licensed to Jisc by the English Place Names Society and released under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License. This serialisation is an adaptation and carries the same terms. plato_commit=ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832
gazetteer.contributor: Conversion: Stephen Gadd (github.com/WorldHistoricalGazetteer/epns). Data: English Place-Name Society, digitised by DEEP, published by Jisc.
